title: Minimum Number Of People To Teach
description:
There are `n` languages and users with language lists. A friendship can communicate when its two users share a language. Choose one language and teach it to a set of users so every friendship can communicate. Return the fewest users that must be taught.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 2, languages = [[1],[2],[1,2]], friendships = [[1,2],[1,3],[2,3]]
Output: 1
```

```text
Input: n = 3, languages = [[2],[1,3],[1,2],[3]], friendships = [[1,4],[1,2],[3,4],[2,3]]
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- `2 <= n <= 500`; there are 1..500 users
- Each user knows 1..n distinct valid languages
- Friendships use distinct valid user pairs; there are 1..500 friendships
